segments.heading: From a FHIR server to a dashboard
lines: FHIR Data Pipes builds the warehouse; Catalyst asks it a question;
Superset shows the answer. Nothing here is a mock.

segments.caption: FHIR Data Pipes reads a live OpenMRS FHIR R4 endpoint.
Parquet files and ViewDefinition views — the warehouse it ships with.
A microbatch run merges what changed, then names the snapshot it wrote.

segments.heading: Ask that warehouse a question
lines: Spark reports the schema. The model has never seen a curated list.

segments.caption: 24 relations, discovered from Spark. One question, in plain language.
A 12B writer drafts the SQL; a 14B reviewer checks it.
Spark SQL against default.patient — 5,384 patients, read from Parquet.
The exact result is saved as a Dataset.

segments.heading: Refine it in conversation
lines: The follow-up starts from the query on screen, not from scratch.

segments.caption: “Now break that count down by gender, highest first.”
Same two models, same source, second turn.
Counts by gender, saved as a second Dataset.

segments.heading: Publish it to Superset
lines: Two Widgets, one Dashboard, one deterministic native bundle.

segments.caption: Widgets over the saved Datasets, collected into a Dashboard.
A pinned importer brings the bundle in and records a receipt.
The same numbers in Superset — 5.38k — from the same Spark source.

segments.heading: openclinai.org
lines: FHIR Data Pipes → Parquet → Spark SQL → Catalyst → Superset
